decisions.reason: Because this biodynamic yogurt is close to the core range and was still actively presented a year after launch, its observed acceptance likely meets aspiration levels and the firm has little reason to reallocate those resources.

This mild sliced cheese fits the firm's established dairy capabilities and broad assortment, so with no visible sign of failure and some room to carry incremental line extensions, management would likely keep it while monitoring performance.

This sliced butter cheese also sits near the firm's existing cheesemaking strengths, and although it is newer and therefore a bit more uncertain, the growing market and the firm's product breadth make retention more likely than withdrawal.
